item.title: Trio charged with drug offenses from Roseville, Detroit raids
item.description: Investigators said they seized 20 grams of crack cocaine, two grams of fentanyl, nine grams of diazepam (valium), several scales and packaging materials, $3,000 in cash, and a Chevrolet Tahoe.

item.title: Pentagon to cut ties with Columbia, Yale, Brown and others Hegseth accuses of ‘wokeness’
item.description: Hegseth said the universities have become “breeding grounds of toxic indoctrination” that undermine military values.

item.title: Federal judge extends order protecting refugees in Minnesota from being arrested and deported
item.description: The order applies only in Minnesota.

item.title: Treasury Department terminates union contracts for IRS and Bureau of the Fiscal Service workers
item.description: Workers at the Bureau of the Fiscal Service are also affected.

item.title: Driver in critical condition after crashing into Priority Waste truck
item.description: Sterling Heights roadway closed for hours as police conduct an investigation

item.title: Lions’ Terrion Arnold denies alleged link to robbery, kidnapping case in Florida
item.description: Detroit Lions cornerback Terrion Arnold is denying his alleged link to an armed robbery and kidnapping case in Florida after his name appeared in court documents this week.

item.title: Falcons dismiss ex-UM assistant coach LaTroy Lewis, who has been named a suspect in a sexual assault case
item.description: The Atlanta Falcons dismissed assistant defensive line coach LaTroy Lewis on Friday, just hours before he was named as a suspect in a sexual assault case. The dismissal came shortly after the Falcons said they were looking into allegations that surfaced on social media.

item.title: No. 3 Michigan claims Big Ten regular-season title with an 84-70 win over No. 10 Illinois
item.description: Morez Johnson Jr. had 19 points and 11 rebounds against his former team as No. 3 Michigan defeated No. 10 Illinois 84-70 on Friday night and clinched Big Ten regular-season title.

item.title: Pistons outlast short-handed Cavaliers 122-119 in OT after blaring horn delay
item.description: Jalen Duren had 33 points and 16 rebounds and the Detroit Pistons outlasted the short-handed Cleveland Cavaliers 122-119 on Friday night in a game that was delayed for 18 minutes in the third quarter because of a blaring horn.
